prose: Agent37, a YC F26 startup, launches on Hacker News with sandboxes for running AI agents at under 10% of the usual provider cost, citing an average of $0.37 per month per sandbox. Basis: the Launch HN post's opening excerpt only.
highlights: Low-cost agent sandboxes, claimed under 10% of typical provider prices.
Average customer spend quoted at $0.37 per sandbox per month.
